title: Immaculate Constellation report describes a large strategic intelligence project on UAP data

Michael Shallon, this journalist, just testified in front of Congress, put out this 12-page report, uh, Immaculate Constellation, this program that seemed to be some unagnowledged special access program in the US.
tellings.difference: Calls it a 12-page report on an unacknowledged special access program and links it to Shellenberger's congressional testimony; it does not say it was a large strategic intelligence project.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Michael Shellenberger's 2024 Immaculate Constellation report, told as a document he published and spoke about to Congress.

tellings.quote: The source of that document told Public, me, that the USAP is a strategic intelligence program that is part of the U.S. military family of longstanding, highly sensitive programs dealing with various aspects of the UAP problem.

plain: The journalist Michael Shellenberger tells Michels that an unsigned report called Immaculate Constellation reveals "a very large strategic intelligence project" inside the US military that gathers reports of UAP, the official term for UFOs. Shellenberger handed the report to Congress, and Rep. Nancy Mace entered it into the record of a House Oversight hearing on 13 November 2024 as a document from the Pentagon. The report calls itself the public version of a Defense Department employee's report, cleared for release by the State Department. A former Defense Department official named Matthew Brown later said he wrote it, and a Defense Department spokesperson said the department has no record of a program by that name. The report describes "a central or 'parent' USAP", meaning an unacknowledged special access program, a secret program whose existence the government does not admit, that "consolidates observations" and serves as "a nexus for collecting, analyzing, and disseminating intelligence." At the hearing, Shellenberger said the report's source told him it was "a strategic intelligence program" belonging to a long-running family of highly sensitive programs. Michels, for his part, calls it a 12-page report on a secret program of this kind. The report's words describe a program that pulls reports together; how large that program is comes from the tellers, not from the report.

discussion.by: Immaculate Constellation report (anonymous, entered into the House Oversight hearing record, 13 November 2024)
discussion.text: An unsigned report that Michael Shellenberger delivered to Congress and Rep. Nancy Mace entered into the record of the House Oversight hearing of 13 November 2024 as a document from the Pentagon; it calls itself the public version of a Defense Department employee's report, cleared for release by the State Department; Matthew Brown, a former Defense Department official, later said he wrote it; and a Defense Department spokesperson said the department has no record of a program by that name. The report calls the program "a central or 'parent' USAP that consolidates observations of UAP and ARV activities" and "a nexus for collecting, analyzing, and disseminating intelligence" on them. Michael Shellenberger's "very large strategic intelligence project" is his summary of it, which he told the hearing came from the report's source; the report's own words are a consolidating program, and the size of what it holds is the tellers' account.
